latestVersion.changelog:
wedding-skill 1.0.0 – Your self-learning wedding planning co-pilot

- Tracks budgets, vendors, guest list, timeline, and decision log—all stored locally on your device.
- Honest budget tracker flags overspending early and suggests practical adjustments.
- Centralizes all vendor details, deadlines, contract terms, and crucial notes in one place.
- Manages guest list RSVPs, dietary needs, and generates seating charts that minimize conflicts.
- Maintains comprehensive planning timelines and creates a detailed day-of schedule.
- Logs couple decisions and preferences, supports compromise tracking, and helps resolve family dynamics.
- Prioritizes privacy: never accesses financial institutions or transmits your data externally.
